newsitem.title: THAILAND: Parliament set to debate 1997/98 budget.
newsitem.headline: Parliament set to debate 1997/98 budget.

text.p: The government of Prime Minister Chavalit Yongchaiyudh on Tuesday approved a June 25 schedule for parliament to debate on the 1997/1998 (October/September) fiscal budget, a government official said.
He said the debate during the first reading of the 982 billion baht ($39.3 billion) budget would likely last three days.

Chavalit's six-party coalition last month trimmed next year's originally planned budget by 26.59 billion baht to help the government maintain its balanced, deficit-free budget policy adopted since late 1980s.
The budget cut next year was essential as Thailand's sluggish economy would likely prevent the government from meeting its tax revenue target.
